pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

2. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

4. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Photography.

5. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.

7. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

10. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

12. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Percussion Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Netball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
